name: IC Interface — SOP
description: Cluster of surface-mount interface ICs in SOP packaging, featuring the SOP-20_7.5x12.8mm_P1.27mm footprint and tier B parts including HT12D and HT12E.
selection_hints: Select when needing surface-mount (SMD) interface ICs in SOP packaging.
Verify compatibility with the SOP-20_7.5x12.8mm_P1.27mm footprint.
Choose if using KiCad symbol interface parts such as HT12D or HT12E.
avoid_when: Through-hole assembly or non-SMD mounting is required.
The design requires a footprint standard other than SOP-20_7.5x12.8mm_P1.27mm.
Parts with quality tier ratings higher than tier B are required.
